svg.title: Living cross-stitch goat lowering its glasses
svg.desc: Before removing its glasses, the goat shifts its weight, lifts and replants its front and rear hooves, flicks an ear and settles into its original stance. Cross pixels step along the grid between the two original Figma poses. The star eyes keep their original rainbow gradient while a white glint, aligned to the opposite 45-degree diagonal of the crosses, sweeps once per cycle with the glasses off. The goat and glasses stay dark.
